routing_table.description: Routing table to use (e.g., main, ampr)

ignore_list.description: List of IPs, hostnames, or subnets to ignore in RIPv2 updates. Subnets may use network/mask or network/len (encap) format. Local interface IPs are always ignored by default.

metric.description: Metric applied to routes inserted into the routing table (0–255)

window.description: TCP window size for IP over AX.25 links. 0 disables it (not recommended)

password.description: RIPv2 authentication password. Leave empty to use default or auto-detected

rip_forward_interface.description: Interface on which to forward RIPv2 packets. Empty means disabled

rip_forward_dest.description: Multicast destination IP for RIPv2 forwarding

ampr_rip_forward_interface.description: Interface on which to forward AMPR RIP packets. Empty means disabled

ampr_rip_forward_dest.description: Multicast destination IP for AMPR RIP forwarding

route_hook_cmd.description: Shell command to execute after route set/change (e.g., 'logger updated routes')

gateway.description: Gateway IP or interface name for direct 44net connections. Auto-detected if empty

callsign_locator.description: Callsign@locator string to report to the central gateway (udp:44.182.21.1:59001). Empty disables registration
